name: An☆Devi -ANGEL or DEVIL-
source:
I am hopeless in real life, playing games in my room all day..... My life has been like that for months since I failed the entrance exams of university...... But, an angel appears to save my life, I comes to live the angel together in my room. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE024758.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
现实生活一败涂地，整天在房间玩游戏……自从大学入学考试落榜后，我已过了数月这样的生活……但一名天使出现拯救我，我开始与她同住在房间里。

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE024758.html]DLsite English[/url]]
